findings.reason: All four authentic original tiles, individually viewed at original resolution and hash checked, contain a readable algebraic sequence but no illustration connecting it to endpoint lifting. An exact-sequence row paired with a path-lift square materially clarifies why the pure subgroup is the kernel. This editorial finding warrants an explanatory addition even though the proof is complete.
findings.action: Appended final Remarks with a fenced native TikZ exact sequence and a path-lift square; explained arrow types, exactness, composition conventions, and trivial permutation cases.

correction: Added only the final Remarks illustration and explanatory prose (lines 131–169). Existing source bytes are preserved as an exact prefix; no title, proof, claims, frontmatter, status, sources or dependencies changed.
